proposals.summary: Returns scene bit 3 as exactly 0 or 1; it selects the map-set-zero layout path, without loading a map.

evidence.detail: Returns scene bit 3 as exactly 0 or 1; it selects the map-set-zero layout path, without loading a map.
Map selector case 0 marks bit 3 and selects this map-set-zero table; cases 1 through 23 clear it before selecting their corresponding map tables.
LoadWorldMapArea uses the bit to choose the map1 layout pointer instead of the map0 pointer and dimensions. No precise town or story label is inferred.

evidence.detail: Returns scene bit 4, a stop predicate consumed by the world-scene lifetime and HUD/effect loops.

proposals.summary: Allocates a 0x800-byte stack with signal-1 retries, installs the world-map destination task entry, initializes task scheduling-control field 100 and starts it.

evidence.detail: Installs the destination-selector entry; subsequent code retries allocation until nonzero, assigns stack top +0x7FC and starts the task.
Target loads destination map graphics, moves player cursors, tests 24 selectable destination rectangles and dispatches the chosen map set.

proposals.summary: Runs world-map cursor movement and destination selection, coordinates connected-player confirmation, dispatches the selected map set and restores scene state.

evidence.detail: Marks world-map selection active before initializing its graphics and player cursor state.
Tests unlocked destinations against position/range tables; later renders those destination markers and centered name text.
Shows the text resource associated with the currently selected destination.
Host waits for all connected players to confirm the same destination; clients await host mode 2.
Invokes the map-set destination selector, then clears the active marker and restores related scene state.
